title: The pair-colimit at a prime is a concrete ind-etale henselian local model
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal, $R=A_{\mathfrak p}$, $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak pR$ and $k=R/\mathfrak m$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let $\mathcal E$ have as objects the etale $R$-algebras $B$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] for which the structural map $k\to B/\mathfrak mB$ is an isomorphism, and all $R$-algebra maps as morphisms. Choose a small skeleton $I$ of $\mathcal E$ and a colimit cocone $(C,(\iota_i:B_i\to C))$ of its underlying ring diagram, with structural map $\eta_C:R\to C$, as in [lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization]. Then $I$ is filtered, every $B_i$ is finitely presented over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and this same cocone is a colimit in commutative $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The ring $C$ is henselian local [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], its maximal ideal is $J=\mathfrak mC$, the map $\eta_C$ is local, and the structural map $e_C:k\xrightarrow{\sim}C/J$ is an isomorphism. The three specified maps $A\to R$, $R\xrightarrow{\eta_C}C$, and their composite $A\to C$ are ind-etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0A02 (lemma-henselization), construction, and 0A03 (lemma-henselization-local-ring), locality. Agent-expanded model over the original ring A using algebra.tex Tag 00CR (lemma-localization-colimit) and proetale.tex Tag 097K (lemma-composition-ind-etale); the argument extracted from old item steps 1-3 and 7 is retained verbatim in report.md.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization] to (R,m). Transfer filteredness along e. The forgetful functor from the under category creates connected colimits, so it reflects the given ring-colimit to an algebra-colimit. Whisker the pair-henselization colimit by e and use colimit uniqueness [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] to obtain an R-algebra isomorphism from its vertex D to the specified vertex C. Its ring equivalence E satisfies E composed with eta_D = eta_C. Thus ideal extension and the structural quotient maps commute with E.

source.place: Tag 0A02 (lemma-henselization), construction; explicit universal-property comparison with the chosen skeleton cocone

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine], an etale affine ring map is finitely presented. Apply this to every $R\to B_i$. Step 1 gives a filtered presentation of $C$ by these etale finitely presented $R$-algebras in the category of $R$-algebras. This is precisely the definition of ind-etaleness, so $\eta_C:R\to C$ is ind-etale.

source.place: Tag 0A02 (lemma-henselization), the defining filtered etale presentation

proof.text: For the pair-henselization vertex D, use [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] in its Mathlib root-lifting formulation: HenselianRing.jac already gives mD contained in the Jacobson radical. The unchanged structural quotient is a field, hence mD is maximal. The quotient homomorphism D to D/mD reflects units because its kernel lies in the Jacobson radical. A ring admitting a local map to a field is local, and its maximal ideal is mD. Root lifting for the henselian pair now gives HenselianLocalRing D. Transport this structure along E, and use ideal-map composition to identify the maximal ideal of C with mC. The quotient equivalence induced by E composed with the given structural quotient isomorphism proves bijectivity of the specified quotient map for C. Finally mC equals the maximal ideal, so the maximal-ideal criterion for local homomorphisms makes eta_C local. The local-ring and residue-field notions are [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].

source.place: Tag 0A03 (lemma-henselization-local-ring), first paragraph; Mathlib HenselianRing.jac supplies the radical inclusion directly

proof.text: The adopted source library already proves that every localization is ind-Zariski (Algebra.IndZariski.localization), hence ind-etale (Algebra.IndEtale.of_indZariski). These use the explicit filtered algebra presentation awayColimitPresentation by principal localizations, whose algebra universal property is proved using localization descent. Specialize this proved API to the complement of p and apply RingHom.IndEtale.algebraMap_iff. This gives ind-etaleness of the specified map A to R directly, in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]; no second construction of the ring colimit or affine open-immersion argument is needed.

source.place: Tag 00CR (lemma-localization-colimit), ring specialization; principal localizations are etale

proof.text: Apply the adopted source theorem RingHom.IndEtale.comp to the two specified ind-etale maps. Transport each of the three resulting predicates along the canonical ULift ring equivalences using the proved source invariance under ring isomorphism. By [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra] this is exactly IndEtaleAcrossUniverses for A to R, R to C, and their specified composite. No Noetherian hypothesis is used.

lean.statement: theorem prime_pair_colimit_indEtale_model (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] (I : Type u) [SmallCategory I] (_hI : Skeletal I) (e : I ≌ ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun B : Under (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p)) ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map B.hom) ∧ Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p)).map B.hom.hom) B.hom.hom Ideal.le_comap_map))) (c : Cocone (e.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι _)) (_hc : IsColimit ((Under.forget (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p))).mapCocone c)) : IsFiltered I ∧ (∀ i : I, (e.functor.obj i).obj.hom.hom.FinitePresentation) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧ (∃ hC : HenselianLocalRing c.pt.right, @IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal c.pt.right _ hC.toIsLocalRing = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p)).map c.pt.hom.hom) ∧ IsLocalHom c.pt.hom.hom ∧ Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p)).map c.pt.hom.hom) c.pt.hom.hom Ideal.le_comap_map) ∧ RingHom.IndEtaleAcrossUniverses (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)) ∧ RingHom.IndEtaleAcrossUniverses c.pt.hom.hom ∧ RingHom.IndEtaleAcrossUniverses (c.pt.hom.hom.comp (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p)))
